update.title: Made Night Mode event-driven with manual overrides
update.summary: Changed Night Mode to sleep until the next scheduled boundary and added temporary warm, normal, and automatic controls through Settings Hub.

preview.description: Scheduled boundaries and manual actions wake the same display-state loop before the service returns to sleep.

blocks.body:
## Sleep until something changes

I replaced repeated clock checks with an event-driven loop. Night Mode calculates the next schedule boundary, sets an alarm, and pauses until that alarm or a manual-change signal wakes it. Each wake-up reconciles the display state, then schedules the next one.

blocks.label: Night Mode: the overnight schedule and reminder sequence

blocks.description: Settings Hub shows the current temperature and schedule state beside temporary Warmer Now, Normal Now, and Auto actions.

blocks.body:
## Return temporary choices to the schedule

Warmer Now lasts until the next wake boundary, while Normal Now lasts until the next blue-light start. The available actions change with the current state, and Auto hands control back to the schedule without leaving a hidden permanent setting.

blocks.code:
flowchart LR
  Config[Schedule and state] --> Next[Calculate next boundary]
  Next --> Pause[Set alarm and pause]
  Pause -->|alarm or manual action| Apply[Reconcile display state]
  Apply --> Next
blocks.description: Scheduled alarms and manual actions enter the same state-reconciliation loop.
